component.name: langchain4j-ingest
component.title: LangChain4j Ingest
component.description: Ingest documents into a LangChain4j embedding store: split into segments, embed and store.
component.label: ai

embeddingModel.description: The embedding model used to embed the document segments

embeddingStore.description: The embedding store the ingested segments are written to

embeddingStoreFactory.description: The embedding store factory to use for creating the embedding store if no embeddingStore is provided

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

maxOverlapSize.description: Number of characters adjacent segments share; must be smaller than maxSegmentSize

maxSegmentSize.description: Maximum size of a segment in characters

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelLangChain4jIngestDocumentId.description: The id of the ingested document, for example a file name, an S3 key or a Kafka message key. When present it is stamped into the metadata of every stored segment so retrieval can cite the source document and a later ingestion can find the document's segments again.

pipelineName.description: The name of the ingestion pipeline; stamped into the metadata of every stored segment

embeddingModel.description: The embedding model used to embed the document segments

embeddingStore.description: The embedding store the ingested segments are written to

embeddingStoreFactory.description: The embedding store factory to use for creating the embedding store if no embeddingStore is provided
